enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, with intermittent waking due to poor sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Lies on bed. Closes eyes. Pulls blanket over chest. Turns onto left side. Bends right arm under pillow. Opens eyes. Turns onto back. Adjusts pillow. Closes eyes. Turns onto right side. Pulls blanket up. Bends knees. Stretches legs. Turns onto back. Closes eyes. Repeats turning and adjusting blanket.

enriched_activities.activity: Slow wake-up: lying in bed, checking Messenger and Instagram on phone, easing into the day
enriched_activities.desc: Opens eyes. Turns onto back. Reaches right arm to bedside table. Picks up phone. Unlocks phone with thumb. Taps Messenger icon. Scrolls message list. Opens a chat. Types a reply. Sends message. Taps back. Opens Instagram. Scrolls feed. Double-taps a post. Watches a video. Puts phone face down on bed. Stretches arms above head. Bends knees. Sits up on edge of bed. Places feet on floor. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Shower and personal hygiene, taking daily medication
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on tap. Adjusts water temperature. Steps into shower. Wets body. Picks up soap. Rubs soap on arms. Washes torso. Washes legs. Rinses body. Turns off tap. Picks up towel. Dries face. Dries body. Wraps towel around waist. Steps out. Opens medicine cabinet. Takes medication bottle. Opens cap. Pours one pill into palm. Puts pill in mouth. Fills cup with water. Drinks water. Swallows pill. Closes bottle. Puts bottle back. Closes cabinet.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing a caffeine-free breakfast and packing a lunch container
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Opens fridge. Takes oats and plant milk. Closes fridge. Takes bowl and spoon. Pours oats and plant milk into bowl. Opens microwave. Places bowl inside. Presses start. Opens fridge. Takes lunch container. Fills container with leftovers. Closes container. Places container in bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating breakfast together with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at table. Member 2 sits opposite. Says 'Good morning' to Member 2. Picks up spoon. Eats oatmeal. Member 2 says 'Morning.' Drinks water. Picks up bowl. Eats last spoonful. Puts spoon in bowl. Stands up. Carries bowl to sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Morning walk at a gentle pace for exercise and pain management, picking up a few groceries
enriched_activities.desc: Puts on shoes. Picks up reusable bag. Opens front door. Steps outside. Closes door. Walks along footpath. Turns left at corner. Continues walking at gentle pace. Stops at pedestrian crossing. Presses crossing button. Waits. Crosses street. Walks to grocery store. Opens store door. Picks up shopping basket. Walks to produce aisle. Selects apples. Places apples in basket. Selects bananas. Places bananas in basket. Walks to checkout. Places basket on counter. Pays with card. Puts groceries in reusable bag. Walks out. Walks home.

enriched_activities.activity: PhD research: systematic review screening and public health data cleaning on computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Closes door. Sits at desk. Turns on desk lamp. Opens laptop. Presses power button. Logs in with password. Opens systematic review software. Opens screening spreadsheet. Reads title and abstract. Clicks include button. Reads next record. Clicks exclude button. Opens data cleaning file. Types data into cells. Scrolls down. Checks for missing values. Highlights row. Opens reference manager. Adds citation. Saves file.

enriched_activities.activity: Short stretch and movement break for mild chronic pain and attention reset
enriched_activities.desc: Stands up from chair. Raises both arms overhead. Bends forward. Reaches toward floor. Straightens up. Twists torso left. Twists torso right. Walks to window. Walks back to desk. Sits down.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating lunch at home
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Opens fridge. Takes out vegetables and tofu. Closes fridge. Opens cupboard. Takes pot. Places pot on induction cooker. Presses power button. Pours oil into pot. Cuts tofu. Adds tofu to pot. Stirs with spatula. Adds vegetables. Pours water. Closes lid. Waits. Turns off cooker. Opens lid. Takes bowl. Scoops food into bowl. Sits at table. Eats with chopsticks. Drinks water. Carries bowl to sink. Washes bowl.

enriched_activities.activity: Household admin on phone: paying bills, updating support shift roster, logging maintenance requests, and coordinating household rosters
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up phone. Unlocks phone. Opens banking app. Taps bill payment. Enters amount. Confirms payment. Opens roster app. Updates support shift times. Sends message to supervisor. Opens email. Writes maintenance request. Sends email. Opens household group chat. Types roster message. Sends message. Puts phone down. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking to the disability and aged-care support shift
enriched_activities.desc: Picks up work bag. Puts on shoes. Opens front door. Steps outside. Closes door. Walks along footpath. Turns right at intersection. Crosses street. Waits for traffic light. Crosses second street. Continues walking. Checks phone for time. Puts phone in pocket. Walks to client's house. Opens gate. Walks to front door. Rings doorbell.

enriched_activities.activity: Part-time disability and aged-care support work: assisting clients with daily routines and community access
enriched_activities.desc: Greets client. Enters house. Removes shoes. Washes hands. Assists client with daily routine. Helps client dress. Prepares lunch in kitchen. Opens fridge. Takes out ingredients. Cuts vegetables. Cooks meal. Serves lunch. Sits with client. Eats lunch. Cleans dishes. Wipes counter. Accompanies client for community access. Pushes wheelchair. Walks to bus stop. Boards bus. Rides bus. Walks to park. Sits on bench. Returns home. Assists with evening routine. Documents shift notes. Says goodbye.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking home from the support shift
enriched_activities.desc: Picks up bag. Says goodbye to client. Opens front door. Steps outside. Closes door. Walks along footpath. Turns left at corner. Crosses street. Walks past shops. Checks phone. Puts phone in pocket. Continues walking. Turns right at intersection. Crosses second street. Walks to home. Opens gate. Walks to front door. Unlocks door. Enters house. Closes door.

enriched_activities.activity: Unwinding after the support shift, changing into comfortable clothes and reviewing the evening's tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Closes door. Puts bag on floor. Takes off shoes. Places shoes by door. Takes off work shirt. Hangs shirt in closet. Takes off pants. Hangs pants. Opens drawer. Takes out t-shirt. Puts on t-shirt. Takes out shorts. Puts on shorts. Sits on bed. Picks up phone. Opens task list. Reviews evening tasks. Puts phone on bedside table. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner at home, then quickly cleaning up
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Opens fridge. Takes out vegetables and noodles. Closes fridge. Opens cupboard. Takes pot. Places pot on induction cooker. Presses power. Pours water. Adds noodles. Cuts vegetables. Adds vegetables to pot. Stirs. Turns off cooker. Takes bowl. Scoops noodles into bowl. Sits at table. Eats with chopsticks. Drinks water. Carries bowl to sink. Washes bowl. Wipes counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Leading a structured group activity session with the household game console (solo session as other members are occupied)
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Turns on TV. Picks up remote. Presses power button. Turns on game console. Picks up controller. Presses home button. Selects game. Starts game. Plays. Presses buttons. Moves controller. Pauses game. Drinks water. Resumes game. Plays. Reaches checkpoint. Saves game. Presses pause. Puts controller down. Turns off console. Turns off TV. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Remote elder caregiving coordination: phone calls and paperwork about care arrangements
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Sits at desk. Picks up phone. Opens contacts. Selects elder care contact. Taps call. Holds phone to ear. Speaks about care schedule. Writes notes on paper. Ends call. Opens paperwork folder. Reads care plan. Fills in form. Signs name. Scans form with phone. Sends email with attachment. Puts phone down. Closes folder.

enriched_activities.activity: PhD writing and reading on computer
enriched_activities.desc: Opens laptop. Presses power. Logs in. Opens document. Types paragraph. Reads reference article. Highlights sentence. Copies citation. Pastes citation into document. Types more text. Scrolls up. Edits sentence. Saves document. Opens PDF. Reads methods section. Takes notes on paper. Types notes into document. Checks word count. Saves again. Closes laptop.

enriched_activities.activity: Wind-down: gentle stretching, setting out next day's medication, dimming the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Stands up. Raises arms overhead. Bends forward. Reaches toward floor. Straightens up. Twists torso left. Twists torso right. Sits on floor. Stretches legs. Touches toes. Stands up. Walks to desk. Opens medication organizer. Takes out tomorrow's pills. Places pills in organizer. Closes organizer. Turns desk lamp knob. Dims lamp. Turns off overhead light. Lies on bed. Pulls blanket up. Closes eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lies on bed. Closes eyes. Pulls blanket over chest. Turns onto left side. Bends knees. Adjusts pillow. Turns onto back. Breathes slowly. Turns onto right side. Pulls blanket up. Stretches legs. Turns onto back. Closes eyes. Remains still.
